how_to_apply: Fill in the proforma "Application for the Temporary Engagement to the Post of Assistant Professor on Contract at Graduate School / IIRBS / NIPST for the Academic Year 2026-27", attached with the notification.

Give the details the proforma asks for: personal details, qualifications, NET and Ph.D. details, teaching experience, ICT and innovative teaching practices, and research publications with impact factor, patents, books and chapters.
Scan the original documents named below and attach them.
Email the filled proforma and the scanned copies to [email protected] within 10 days from the date of the notification (07.11.2026).

Late applications, applications not in the prescribed format, and applications without the scanned certificates will summarily be rejected.
important_instructions: Natives of States other than Keralam need not apply for the post notified exclusively under the Community reservation quota. Applications missing scanned certificates for age, community, creamy layer status, educational qualification, experience, CGPA conversion, impact factor or equivalency / eligibility will be rejected.

rows.details: Botany (National Institute of Plant Science Technology, NIPST)

content_sections.heading: About MGU and NIPST
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is the issuer of this notification, signed by the Registrar (i/c), Dr. Binu George Varghese. The post is at its National Institute of Plant Science Technology (NIPST), in the discipline of Botany. The notice is copied to NIPST, the Public Relations Officer and the University website.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: *E/B/T means Ezhava/Billava/Thiyya. The notice says reservation rotation is specified against the vacancy in this table.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Age: as per the UGC Regulations regarding the appointment of Assistant Professors. Teachers who have retired from Colleges/Universities will also be considered, subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice does not state a separate experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification and the UGC norms for the discipline-specific eligibility. Candidates who obtained a Degree/Ph.D. from Universities/Institutions outside the State of Keralam must submit an Equivalency / Eligibility certificate obtained from this University.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract basis for the academic year 2026-2027 (till April 15, 2027). The selected candidate shall execute an agreement with the University as per the existing norms. The notice mentions no allowances in addition to the consolidated pay.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Assistant Professor on Contract
content_sections.text: Fill in the proforma "Application for the Temporary Engagement to the Post of Assistant Professor on Contract at Graduate School / IIRBS / NIPST for the Academic Year 2026-27", attached with the notification. Give the details the proforma asks for: personal details, qualifications, NET and Ph.D. details, teaching experience, ICT and innovative teaching practices, and research publications with impact factor, patents, books and chapters. Scan the original documents named below and attach them. Email the filled proforma and the scanned copies to [email protected] within 10 days from the date of the notification (07.11.2026). The proforma ends with a declaration, signed by the candidate, that all the information is true and that the candidate possesses the original documents to prove the claims. Late applications, applications not in the prescribed format, and applications without the scanned certificates will summarily be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled proforma Proof of age Proof of community reservation, with Community Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for candidates under the community quota Qualification proof: mark lists and degree certificates Proof that the journals are approved by UGC / peer reviewed, and the impact factor of the published articles Experience certificate and awards Proof for CGPA to percentage conversion and proof of all other additional qualifications Equivalency / Eligibility certificate from the University, for degrees or Ph.D. obtained outside the State of Keralam Certificate from the Competent Authority (as per State Govt. criteria) for Differently Abled / EWS candidates

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Natives of States other than Keralam need not apply for the post notified exclusively under the Community reservation quota. In the proforma, teaching experience in guest/contract/temporary positions is counted only after acquiring the minimum qualifications stipulated by the UGC for the post of Assistant Professor. Applications missing scanned certificates for age, community, creamy layer status, educational qualification, experience, CGPA conversion, impact factor or equivalency / eligibility will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor posts has MGU announced?
faq.answer: One post of Assistant Professor on Contract in Botany at NIPST, with reservation E/B/T (Ezhava/Billava/Thiyya).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 10 days from the date of the notification, 07.11.2026, which is about 17 November 2026. Late applications will summarily be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the MGU Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The notice states the qualification as per UGC norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per the UGC Regulations for Assistant Professors. Retired College/University teachers are also considered, with a maximum age of 70 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of ₹40,000 /- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled proforma and scanned copies of the original documents to [email protected] within 10 days from 07.11.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contract basis for the academic year 2026-2027, till April 15, 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired teachers apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Teachers who have retired from Colleges/Universities will also be considered, with a maximum age of 70 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice gives consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month for the post and no separate pay for retired teachers.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: The post is notified exclusively under the Community reservation quota (E/B/T). Natives of States other than Keralam need not apply.

faq.question: Q10. Which certificates are needed for community, EWS or Differently Abled candidates?
faq.answer: Community quota candidates must submit a Community Certificate and a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate. Differently Abled / EWS candidates must enclose the certificate issued by the Competent Authority as per State Govt. criteria.
